documents.title: Refund policy
documents.content: Customers may request a refund within 30 calendar days of purchase. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within five to seven business days.

documents.title: Data retention
documents.content: Workspace audit logs are retained for 365 days. Deleted customer content remains in encrypted backups for up to 30 days before permanent removal.

documents.title: Account deletion
documents.content: Closing a workspace immediately disables member access and starts the deletion workflow. Workspace owners have seven days to cancel a scheduled deletion.

documents.title: Password reset and sessions
documents.content: A password reset link expires after 20 minutes and can be used once. Resetting a password signs the user out of all active sessions.

documents.title: Enterprise support SLA
documents.content: Enterprise plan critical incidents receive an initial response within one hour. High-severity incidents receive an initial response within four hours.

documents.title: Regional data storage
documents.content: Enterprise customers can choose United States or European Union primary data storage. Encrypted disaster recovery copies remain in the selected region.

test_cases.question: How long after purchase can a customer request a refund?
test_cases.expected_answer: Customers may request a refund within 30 calendar days of purchase.

test_cases.question: When does a password reset link expire and what happens to active sessions?
test_cases.expected_answer: A password reset link expires after 20 minutes. Resetting a password signs the user out of all active sessions.

test_cases.question: What is the initial response time for a critical Enterprise incident?
test_cases.expected_answer: Enterprise plan critical incidents receive an initial response within one hour.

test_cases.question: What happens when an owner closes a workspace, and how long can deleted content remain in backups?
test_cases.expected_answer: Closing a workspace immediately disables member access and starts deletion. Deleted customer content remains in encrypted backups for up to 30 days.

test_cases.question: Can Enterprise customers keep both primary data and disaster recovery copies in the European Union?
test_cases.expected_answer: Enterprise customers can choose European Union primary storage, and encrypted disaster recovery copies remain in the selected region.
